wording: Episode-specific self-monitoring provides more useful control than shuffled or distribution-matched monitoring signals.

decision_rule.retain_if: Under the preregistered unannounced-impairment recovery assay, S2 exceeds S3 post-impairment accuracy by >=0.15 in the decision family and >=0.10 in the verification family, with at least 18/20 seeds favouring S2 in each family; the S3 construction must preserve the exact marginal monitor-value multiset.
decision_rule.restrict_if: State-specific correspondence matters in only one family.
decision_rule.reduce_if: Distribution-matched S3 reproduces S2 recovery across both families.
decision_rule.reject_if: Breaking episode-specific monitor correspondence has no reproducible effect.
